name: Clarissa Orbas
original_name: クラリッサ・オルバス
source:
Profession: Runaway Slave
From: The Evil Organization, Komin-Axis
Race: Human
Height: A bit short
Breast size: Big

Komin-Axis is an unidentified mysterious organization aiming for a world revolution. Curiously, they were kidnapping and collecting girls from all over the world that had some sort of "birthmarks" on their bodies. Clarissa, is one of these victims. She was working as a slave for a while. 

One day, Clarissa was lucky enough to escape them. She reached Essenbaum as she continued to flee from the organization's pursuers. There, she met the hero and was saved.

"Um, Umm..... Is it fine to refer to you as big brother?"
